gloss: paternal side; father's side (of the family)

definitions.gloss: paternal side; father's side of the family
definitions.explanation: Refers to relatives, lineage, or characteristics coming from the father's side of the family. Used when distinguishing between maternal and paternal family lines.

examples.japanese: {父方|ちちかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Most of my paternal relatives live in Kyushu.
I've heard that there are many doctors in my father's side of the family.

notes:
USAGE:
{父方|ちちかた} is used to specify the father's side when discussing family relationships, especially grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins. It is typically used as a modifier before a family term: {父方|ちちかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ (paternal grandfather), {父方|ちちかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叔父|おじ} (paternal uncle).

SIMILAR WORDS:
{父方|ちちかた} vs. ⟦{母方|ははかた}→母方：13206_hahakata⟧ (maternal side) — these form a natural pair for distinguishing which side of the family is being discussed.
